# Verify Compilation

The Verify Compilation feature performs a shadow compile to check the equivalence of the current state against a potential fresh compilation. This helps in identifying any divergences without modifying the actual compilation state.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
